name: Unified Multilingual Text Simplification Benchmark
description: Evaluates text simplification quality (readability, simplicity, fluency, and meaning preservation) across multiple non-English languages.
evaluation_method: SARI (primary), BLEU, FKGL/readability metrics, and targeted human evaluation for meaning preservation/fluency
reputation: Well-regarded ACL benchmark for multilingual simplification, cited and used by researchers working on non-English simplification.
notes: Performance varies widely by language and data size; SARI does not fully capture meaning preservation or fluency so human evaluation is often required; risk of pretraining/data contamination for large multilingual LMs.
